title: The generalized Mukai conjecture

abstractEnglish: We prove the generalized Mukai conjecture: every positive-dimensional smooth complex Fano manifold of dimension n, Picard number ρ, and pseudoindex ι satisfies $`\rho(\iota-1)\le n`$. Equality holds precisely for the product of ρ copies of $`\mathbb P^{\iota-1}`$.
